[[File:Tears_of_the_Rist.png|thumb|right|200px|Tears of the Rist]]
The '''Tears of Rist''' was an extremely powerful toxin that was used by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] of [[House Rist]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The elite Rists that used the poison were known to have camps in the wilderness along the [[Lowlands Road]], [[Juran Crossroads]] and the [[contested valley]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]].

In the Cold War era, an official of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] discovered that a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] working for [[House of Thul|House Thul]] had been killed by an assassin using the Tears of Rist. This led to a mission to collecting samples of the toxin.
